mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sales_case (case_id, user_id, session_id, user_message, stage, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{userMessage}, #{stage}, NOW(6), NOW(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE after_sales_case SET order_id = #{orderId}, stage = #{stage}, checkpoint_id = #{checkpointId}, next_node = #{nextNode}, terminal_reason = #{terminalReason}, command_id = #{commandId}, resume_token = NULL, resume_locked_until = NULL, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE case_id = #{caseId}
mapper.select: SELECT case_id, user_id, session_id, user_message, order_id, stage, checkpoint_id, resume_token, resume_locked_until, next_node, terminal_reason, command_id FROM after_sales_case WHERE case_id = #{caseId}
mapper.update: UPDATE after_sales_case SET stage = 'REJECTED', terminal_reason = #{reason}, resume_token = NULL, resume_locked_until = NULL, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND stage NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'REJECTED')
UPDATE after_sales_case SET stage = 'COMPLETED', command_id = #{commandId}, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE case_id = #{caseId}

UPDATE after_sales_case SET resume_token = #{resumeToken}, resume_locked_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(6), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND checkpoint_id = #{checkpointId} AND (resume_token IS NULL OR resume_locked_until IS NULL OR resume_locked_until <= NOW(6))
UPDATE after_sales_case SET resume_token = NULL, resume_locked_until = NULL, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND resume_token = #{resumeToken}
